camel_example: aliyun ice UpdateLiveSnapshotTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --TimeInterval 5 --TemplateName Template_1 --TemplateId '0000a046-263c-3560-978a-fb2877820000' --version 2020-11-09 --method POST --force
name: UpdateLiveSnapshotTemplate

parameters.help_en: The template name. The maximum length is 128 characters
parameters.help_zh:
模板名称。
最大长度为128
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
The file format for overwrite snapshots.
It cannot start with a forward slash (/) and currently supports only the .jpg extension.
The maximum length is 255 characters.
Supported placeholder: {JobId}, which indicates the snapshot job ID.
Placeholders such as {UnixTimestamp}, {Sequence}, and {Date} are not allowed.
You must specify at least one of the file formats for overwrite snapshots and sequence snapshots
parameters.help_zh:
覆盖截图文件格式。

不能以“/”开头，目前只支持.jpg后缀。
最大长度为255。
支持占位符： {JobId}：截图任务ID
不允许填写{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}、{Date}等占位符。
覆盖截图和序列截图的文件格式至少要设置一个
parameters.name: overwrite_format

parameters.help_en:
The file format for sequence snapshots.
It cannot start with a forward slash (/) and currently supports only the .jpg extension.
The maximum length is 255 characters.
Supported placeholders: {JobId} (snapshot job ID), {Date} (snapshot date), {UnixTimestamp} (timestamp), and {Sequence} (sequence number). You must specify at least one of {UnixTimestamp} and {Sequence}.
You must specify at least one of the file formats for overwrite snapshots and sequence snapshots
parameters.help_zh:
序列截图文件格式。
不能以“/”开头，目前只支持.jpg后缀。
最大长度为255。
支持占位符：{JobId}：截图任务ID、{Date}：截图日期、{UnixTimestamp}：时间戳、{Sequence}：序列号，其中{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}至少要填写一个。
覆盖截图和序列截图的文件格式至少要设置一个
parameters.name: sequence_format

parameters.help_en: The time interval between snapshots, in seconds. Valid values: 5 to 3600
parameters.help_zh:
截图时间间隔，单位：秒。
取值范围是[5, 3600]
parameters.name: time_interval
